scientific_integrity: Exact finite-graph all-size theorem with proved equality cases and rational finite checks; same-model-reviewed, not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Only strictly ordered positive shore sizes, three colors, one favored color, uniform positive exchange, nonnegative field, zero temperature. Degree-scaled field limits are not fixed-field thermodynamic transitions. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Two field thresholds and exact critical occupation polynomials in a tripartite Potts antiferromagnet
